schema: CREATE TABLE `knex_migrations` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `name` varchar(255), `batch` integer, `migration_time` datetime)
CREATE TABLE `knex_migrations_lock` (`index` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `is_locked` integer)

CREATE TABLE `admin_users` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `username` varchar(255) not null, `password` varchar(255) not null, `email` varchar(255) not null, `role` varchar(255) not null, `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE `sonarr_instances` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `name` varchar(255) not null, `base_url` varchar(255) not null, `api_key` varchar(255) not null, `quality_profile` varchar(255), `root_folder` varchar(255), `bypass_ignored` boolean default '0', `season_monitoring` varchar(255) default 'all', `tags` json default '[]', `synced_instances` json default '[]', `is_default` boolean default '0', `is_enabled` boolean default '1', `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `monitor_new_items` varchar(255) default 'all', `search_on_add` boolean default '1', `series_type` varchar(255) default 'standard', `create_season_folders` boolean default '0', `skip_default_routing_when_no_match` boolean default '0')

CREATE TABLE `radarr_instances` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `name` varchar(255) not null, `base_url` varchar(255) not null, `api_key` varchar(255) not null, `quality_profile` varchar(255), `root_folder` varchar(255), `bypass_ignored` boolean default '0', `tags` json default '[]', `synced_instances` json default '[]', `is_default` boolean default '0', `is_enabled` boolean default '1', `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `search_on_add` boolean default '1', `minimum_availability` varchar(255) default 'released', `monitor` varchar(20) default 'movieOnly', `skip_default_routing_when_no_match` boolean default '0')

CREATE TABLE `watchlist_items` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `user_id` integer not null, `title` varchar(255) not null, `key` varchar(255) not null, `type` varchar(255) not null, `thumb` varchar(255), `added` varchar(255), `guids` json, `genres` json, `status` text check (`status` in ('pending', 'requested', 'grabbed', 'notified')) not null default 'pending', `last_notified_at` datetime null, `series_status` text check (`series_status` in ('continuing', 'ended')), `movie_status` text check (`movie_status` in ('available', 'unavailable')), `sonarr_instance_id` integer, `radarr_instance_id` integer, `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `imdb_rating` float null, `imdb_votes` integer null, `rt_critic_rating` float null, `rt_audience_rating` float null, `tmdb_rating` float null, foreign key(`user_id`) references `users`(`id`) on delete CASCADE, foreign key(`sonarr_instance_id`) references `sonarr_instances`(`id`) on delete SET NULL, foreign key(`radarr_instance_id`) references `radarr_instances`(`id`) on delete SET NULL)

CREATE TABLE `genres` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `name` varchar(255) not null, `is_custom` boolean default '0', `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE `watchlist_status_history` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `watchlist_item_id` integer not null, `status` text check (`status` in ('pending', 'requested', 'grabbed', 'notified')) not null, `timestamp` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key(`watchlist_item_id`) references `watchlist_items`(`id`) on delete CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE `watchlist_radarr_instances` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `watchlist_id` integer not null, `radarr_instance_id` integer not null, `is_primary` boolean default '0', `status` text check (`status` in ('pending', 'requested', 'grabbed', 'notified')) not null default 'pending', `last_notified_at` datetime null, `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `syncing` boolean not null default '0', foreign key(`watchlist_id`) references `watchlist_items`(`id`) on delete CASCADE, foreign key(`radarr_instance_id`) references `radarr_instances`(`id`) on delete CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE `watchlist_sonarr_instances` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `watchlist_id` integer not null, `sonarr_instance_id` integer not null, `is_primary` boolean default '0', `status` text check (`status` in ('pending', 'requested', 'grabbed', 'notified')) not null default 'pending', `last_notified_at` datetime null, `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `syncing` boolean not null default '0', `sonarr_series_id` integer null, foreign key(`watchlist_id`) references `watchlist_items`(`id`) on delete CASCADE, foreign key(`sonarr_instance_id`) references `sonarr_instances`(`id`) on delete CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE `schedules` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `name` varchar(255) not null, `type` varchar(255) not null, `config` json not null, `enabled` boolean default '1', `last_run` json null, `next_run` json null, `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE `pending_webhooks` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `instance_type` varchar(10) not null, `instance_id` integer null, `guid` varchar(255) not null, `title` varchar(255) not null, `media_type` varchar(10) not null, `payload` json not null, `received_at` datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `expires_at` datetime not null, check ("instance_type" IN ('radarr', 'sonarr')), check ("media_type" IN ('movie', 'show')))

CREATE TABLE `quota_usage` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `user_id` integer not null, `content_type` text check (`content_type` in ('movie', 'show')) not null, `request_date` date not null, `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key(`user_id`) references `users`(`id`) on delete CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "user_quotas" (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `user_id` integer not null, `content_type` text check (`content_type` in ('movie', 'show')) not null, `quota_type` text check (`quota_type` in ('daily', 'weekly_rolling', 'monthly')) not null, `quota_limit` integer not null, `bypass_approval` boolean default '0', `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "watchlist_cap" integer null default null, foreign key(`user_id`) references `users`(`id`) on delete CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE `anime_ids` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `external_id` varchar(255) not null, `source` varchar(255) not null, `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE `pending_label_syncs` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `watchlist_item_id` integer not null, `content_title` varchar(255) not null, `webhook_tags` json not null default '[]', `retry_count` integer default '0', `last_retry_at` datetime null, `created_at` datetime default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `expires_at` datetime not null, foreign key(`watchlist_item_id`) references `watchlist_items`(`id`) on delete CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "api_keys" (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `key` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `is_active` boolean DEFAULT '1', `user_id` integer NULL, FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `admin_users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "approval_requests" (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `user_id` integer NOT NULL, `content_type` text NOT NULL CHECK (`content_type` in('movie' , 'show')), `content_title` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `content_key` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `content_guids` json DEFAULT '[]', `router_decision` json NOT NULL, `router_rule_id` integer NULL, `approval_reason` text NULL, `triggered_by` text NOT NULL CHECK (`triggered_by` in('quota_exceeded' , 'router_rule' , 'manual_flag' , 'content_criteria')), `approved_by` integer NULL, `approval_notes` text NULL, `expires_at` datetime NULL, `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "status" text NOT NULL CHECK ("status" in('pending' , 'approved' , 'rejected' , 'expired' , 'auto_approved')) DEFAULT 'pending', `thumb` varchar(255) null, FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (`approved_by`) REFERENCES `admin_users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL)

CREATE TABLE "plex_label_tracking" (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        content_guids TEXT NOT NULL,
        content_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(content_type IN ('movie', 'show')),
        user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        plex_rating_key VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
        labels_applied TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        synced_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        UNIQUE(content_guids, user_id, content_type, plex_rating_key)
      )

CREATE TABLE `webhook_endpoints` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `name` varchar(255) not null, `url` varchar(255) not null, `auth_header_name` varchar(255) null, `auth_header_value` varchar(255) null, `event_types` json not null, `enabled` boolean not null default '1', `created_at` datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE "users" (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `apprise` varchar(255) NULL, `alias` varchar(255) NULL, `discord_id` varchar(255), `notify_apprise` boolean DEFAULT '0', `notify_discord` boolean DEFAULT '0', `can_sync` boolean DEFAULT '1', `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `is_primary_token` boolean DEFAULT '0', `notify_plex_mobile` boolean DEFAULT '0', `requires_approval` boolean DEFAULT '0', `notify_discord_mention` boolean DEFAULT '1', `plex_uuid` varchar(255) NULL, `avatar` varchar(255) NULL, `display_name` varchar(255) NULL, `friend_created_at` varchar(255) NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `idx_unique_primary_token` on `users` (`is_primary_token`) where is_primary_token = 1

CREATE TABLE "configs" (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `port` integer, `dbPath` varchar(255), `baseUrl` varchar(255), `cookieSecret` varchar(255), `cookieName` varchar(255), `cookieSecured` boolean, `logLevel` varchar(255), `closeGraceDelay` integer, `rateLimitMax` integer, `queueProcessDelaySeconds` integer DEFAULT '60', `discordWebhookUrl` varchar(255), `discordBotToken` varchar(255), `discordClientId` varchar(255), `queueWaitTime` integer DEFAULT '120000', `newEpisodeThreshold` integer DEFAULT '172800000', `plexTokens` json, `skipFriendSync` boolean, `deleteMovie` boolean, `deleteEndedShow` boolean, `deleteContinuingShow` boolean, `deleteFiles` boolean, `selfRss` varchar(255), `friendsRss` varchar(255), `_isReady` boolean DEFAULT '0', `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `respectUserSyncSetting` boolean DEFAULT '1', `deleteSyncNotify` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'none', `maxDeletionPrevention` integer DEFAULT '10', `enableApprise` boolean DEFAULT '0', `appriseUrl` varchar(255) DEFAULT '', `systemAppriseUrl` varchar(255) NULL, `tagUsersInSonarr` boolean DEFAULT '0', `tagUsersInRadarr` boolean DEFAULT '0', `cleanupOrphanedTags` boolean DEFAULT '1', `persistHistoricalTags` boolean DEFAULT '0', `tagPrefix` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'pulsarr:user', `enablePlexPlaylistProtection` boolean DEFAULT '0', `plexProtectionPlaylistName` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'Do Not Delete', `plexServerUrl` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'http://localhost:32400', `removedTagMode` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'remove', `removedTagPrefix` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'pulsarr:removed', `deletionMode` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'watchlist', `pendingWebhookRetryInterval` integer DEFAULT '20', `pendingWebhookMaxAge` integer DEFAULT '10', `pendingWebhookCleanupInterval` integer DEFAULT '60', `plexMobileEnabled` boolean DEFAULT '0', `deleteSyncNotifyOnlyOnDeletion` boolean DEFAULT '0', `plexSessionMonitoring` json NULL, `newUserDefaultCanSync` boolean DEFAULT '1', `publicContentNotifications` json NULL, `quotaSettings` json NULL, `approvalExpiration` json NULL, `approvalNotify` text CHECK (`approvalNotify` in('none' , 'all' , 'discord-only' , 'apprise-only' , 'webhook-only' , 'dm-only' , 'discord-webhook' , 'discord-message' , 'discord-both')) DEFAULT 'none', `newUserDefaultRequiresApproval` boolean DEFAULT '0', `newUserDefaultMovieQuotaEnabled` boolean DEFAULT '0', `newUserDefaultMovieQuotaType` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'monthly', `newUserDefaultMovieQuotaLimit` integer DEFAULT '10', `newUserDefaultMovieBypassApproval` boolean DEFAULT '0', `newUserDefaultShowQuotaEnabled` boolean DEFAULT '0', `newUserDefaultShowQuotaType` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'monthly', `newUserDefaultShowQuotaLimit` integer DEFAULT '10', `newUserDefaultShowBypassApproval` boolean DEFAULT '0', `tmdbRegion` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'US', `plexLabelSync` json NULL, `deleteSyncTrackedOnly` boolean DEFAULT '0', `deleteSyncCleanupApprovals` boolean DEFAULT '0', `deleteSyncRequiredTagRegex` text NULL, `skipIfExistsOnPlex` boolean DEFAULT '0', `tagMigration` json NULL, `appriseEmailSender` varchar(255) NULL, "newUserDefaultMovieWatchlistCap" integer null default null, "newUserDefaultShowWatchlistCap" integer null default null, `watchlistCapNotify` varchar(255) default 'none', `watchlistCapNotifyUser` boolean default '0', `tagNamingSource` varchar(255) not null default 'username', `notifyOnUpdate` varchar(255) not null default 'none', `lastNotifiedVersion` varchar(255) null, `watchlistAddNotify` varchar(255) not null default 'all', `notifyOnAvailability` boolean not null default '1', `webhookSecret` varchar(255) null, `maintainerrEnabled` boolean not null default '0', `maintainerrUrl` varchar(255) null, `maintainerrWebhookSecret` varchar(255) null, `maintainerrExclusionMode` varchar(255) not null default 'watchlisters')

CREATE TABLE "rolling_monitored_shows" (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `sonarr_series_id` integer NOT NULL, `sonarr_instance_id` integer NOT NULL, `tvdb_id` varchar(255) NULL, `imdb_id` varchar(255) NULL, `show_title` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `current_monitored_season` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', `last_watched_season` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `last_watched_episode` integer NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `last_session_date` datetime NULL, `plex_user_id` varchar(255) NULL, `plex_username` varchar(255) NULL, `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `last_updated_at` datetime NOT NULL, "monitoring_type" text NOT NULL CHECK ("monitoring_type" in('pilotRolling' , 'firstSeasonRolling' , 'allSeasonPilotRolling')) DEFAULT 'pilotRolling', `plex_user_uuid` varchar(255) null, FOREIGN KEY (`sonarr_instance_id`) REFERENCES `sonarr_instances` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "notifications" (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `watchlist_item_id` integer NULL, `user_id` integer NULL, `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `message` varchar(255) NULL, `season_number` integer NULL, `episode_number` integer NULL, `sent_to_discord` boolean DEFAULT '0', `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `notification_status` varchar(255) DEFAULT 'active', `sent_to_apprise` boolean DEFAULT '0', `sent_to_plex_mobile` boolean DEFAULT '0', `sent_to_native_webhook` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', "type" text NOT NULL CHECK ("type" in('episode' , 'season' , 'movie' , 'watchlist_add' , 'watchlist_removed' , 'approval_resolved' , 'approval_auto' , 'user_created' , 'watchlist_cap')) DEFAULT 'episode', FOREIGN KEY (`watchlist_item_id`) REFERENCES `watchlist_items` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE `watchlist_exclusions` (`id` integer not null primary key autoincrement, `user_id` integer not null, `key` varchar(255) not null, `title` varchar(255) not null, `type` varchar(255) not null, `guids` json not null default '[]', `excluded_at` datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, foreign key(`user_id`) references `users`(`id`) on delete CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE "router_rules" (`id` integer PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `type` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `criteria` json NOT NULL, `target_type` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `target_instance_id` integer, `root_folder` varchar(255), `quality_profile` integer, `order` integer DEFAULT '50', `enabled` boolean DEFAULT '1', `metadata` json NULL, `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `tags` json DEFAULT '[]', `search_on_add` boolean NULL, `season_monitoring` varchar(255) NULL, `series_type` varchar(255) NULL, `always_require_approval` boolean DEFAULT '0', `bypass_user_quotas` boolean DEFAULT '0', `approval_reason` varchar(255) NULL, `monitor` varchar(20) NULL, `exclude_from_routing` boolean DEFAULT '0')

CREATE TRIGGER fk_router_rules_sonarr_delete
    BEFORE DELETE ON sonarr_instances
    FOR EACH ROW
    BEGIN
      DELETE FROM router_rules
      WHERE target_type = 'sonarr' AND target_instance_id = OLD.id;
    END

CREATE TRIGGER fk_router_rules_radarr_delete
    BEFORE DELETE ON radarr_instances
    FOR EACH ROW
    BEGIN
      DELETE FROM router_rules
      WHERE target_type = 'radarr' AND target_instance_id = OLD.id;
    END
